failure.instruction_quote: A canary whose sampled error rate exceeds config.errorThreshold (default 0.10) for at least config.minSamples (default 50) samples enters 'rolledback' phase and never advances to 'promoted'.
failure.explanation: The agent tested rollback with all-error records (step 15-16) and reload persistence, but never tested the happy path of sending all-success records to confirm promotion works. The healthy canary test sends 80 all-200 records and expects 'promoted', but the implementation incorrectly rolls back (sampleCount=68, rolledback), indicating the error-rate or promotion logic in the fixed server.js/health-window is still misclassifying records. The agent declared success without testing this critical path.
